t_advice_summary_textbox.text: avoid blue and  yellow. look out for height patterns. take advantage of breaks.

vb_textbox.text: I think it is mostly random. I picked tall pink and purple, small red as preferences as these seemed to have the most mushrooms and the least rounds of 0. I avoided brown and blue, and avoided small orange. Best advice is just to make sure you pick one in the time frame and remember to press for the basket. Good luck :)
